# Run DS vs TC comparisons
# Anno and timepoint addition to newly created naive_CD4_AIMpp.Rdata, only! (RG 08 Enero 2026)

```{r annotate_naive_CD4_AIMpp, message=TRUE}

library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# ---- Paths ----
baseDir <- "/Users/rgomez/Khor_covidvax_response_IMPACD"
target_file <- file.path(baseDir, "data/counts/flow", "naive_CD4_AIMpp.Rdata")

stopifnot(file.exists(target_file))

metadata_annotation <- read.csv(
  file.path(baseDir, "flow_annotation", "DS_with_annotation_flow.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

timepoint_key <- read.csv(
  file.path(baseDir, "flow_annotation", "longitudinalDrawDescription_Timepoint_key.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# ---- Load the one matrices object ----
message("\nAnnotating ONLY: ", target_file)
load(target_file)  # loads "matrices"
stopifnot(exists("matrices"))

# Basic structure checks
stopifnot(is.list(matrices))
stopifnot("design" %in% names(matrices))
stopifnot(is.data.frame(matrices$design))
stopifnot("sampleName" %in% colnames(matrices$design))

# ---- 1) Patch metadata for a small set of samples ----
samples_needing_update <- c(
  "exp_D_MN_B06_AL044", "exp_C_CE_B06_AL044", "exp_A_DM_B06_AL044", "exp_B_SP_B06_AL044",
  "exp_A_DM_B08_AL065", "exp_B_SP_B08_AL065", "exp_D_MN_B08_AL065", "exp_C_CE_B08_AL065",
  "exp_C_CE_B08_AL069", "exp_A_DM_B08_AL069", "exp_B_SP_B08_AL069", "exp_D_MN_B08_AL069",
  "exp_C_CE_B17_AL149", "exp_B_SP_B17_AL149", "exp_D_MN_B17_AL149", "exp_A_DM_B17_AL149",
  "exp_A_DM_B17_AL158", "exp_B_SP_B17_AL158", "exp_C_CE_B17_AL158", "exp_D_MN_B17_AL158"
)

update_metadata <- metadata_annotation %>%
  filter(sampleName %in% samples_needing_update) %>%
  select(sampleName, ageAtDraw, sex, longitudinalDrawDescription, patientType)

# Join + fill only missing values (existing values win)
matrices$design <- matrices$design %>%
  left_join(update_metadata, by = "sampleName", suffix = c("", ".new")) %>%
  mutate(
    ageAtDraw = coalesce(ageAtDraw, ageAtDraw.new),
    sex = coalesce(sex, sex.new),
    longitudinalDrawDescription = coalesce(longitudinalDrawDescription, longitudinalDrawDescription.new),
    patientType = coalesce(patientType, patientType.new)
  ) %>%
  select(-ends_with(".new"))

# ---- 2) Add/refresh timePoint from longitudinalDrawDescription ----
# (timepoint_key must have columns: longitudinalDrawDescription, timePoint)
matrices$design <- matrices$design %>%
  left_join(timepoint_key, by = "longitudinalDrawDescription") %>%
  rename(timePoint = timePoint)

# ---- 3) One-off timePoint correction for AL073 samples (set to T1) ----
samples_timePoint_fix <- c(
  "exp_C_CE_B09_AL073",
  "exp_A_DM_B09_AL073",
  "exp_B_SP_B09_AL073"
)

matrices$design <- matrices$design %>%
  mutate(timePoint = ifelse(sampleName %in% samples_timePoint_fix, "T1", timePoint))

# ---- Quick verification ----
message("Rows in design: ", nrow(matrices$design))
message("Non-NA timePoint: ", sum(!is.na(matrices$design$timePoint)))
message("AL073 timePoint values: ")
print(matrices$design %>% filter(sampleName %in% samples_timePoint_fix) %>% select(sampleName, longitudinalDrawDescription, timePoint))

# ---- Save back to the same file ----
save(matrices, file = target_file)
message("✅ Annotated and saved: ", target_file)


```

# Aging
```{r run aging analyses}
source("cytof_functions.R")

# list all R data files in data/counts
files = list.files("data/counts", pattern = ".Rdata", full.names = T)


for (iFile in 1:length(files) ) {
# for (iFile in 30 ) {
  file = files[iFile]
  # extract the name of the file, without the path and extension
  name = gsub("data/counts/", "", file)
  name = gsub(".Rdata", "", name)
  
  run_age_analysis(name)
}

```
